_readme: An entry means: the checker reports this `.rpc()` name as absent from the functions replayed from supabase/migrations, and we have DECIDED, for a stated reason, to let it through until the expiry.
Empty is the healthy state. Correct the name, create the function in a forward-only migration, or delete the call, before reaching for this file.
file     repo-relative path exactly as the checker prints it, e.g. "src/lib/sequences/enrol.js"
name     the function name passed to .rpc() (covers every call of that name in that file)

reason   WHY it may pass. For a function that exists in prod but whose DDL this replay cannot read: say you read pg_proc on the live project, and when. For a known phantom awaiting its fix: name the row and the PR.
expires  YYYY-MM-DD. Past this date the gate FAILS until someone re-decides. A month at most.
Entries cannot rot: an expired entry fails exactly like an unlisted name.
